description: This header file contains AVX2 optimized implementations for upsampling and resampling image tensors, specifically targeting the CPU with AVX2 support. It includes functions for horizontal and vertical convolution-based image resizing, with support for RGB and RGBA formats, leveraging SIMD instructions for performance.
